crossRefs.note: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges…
Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out…
I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his…
When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after…
Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh…
The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will…
For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did…
As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh…
Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have…
He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of…
The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”
Today, Yahweh will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you, and take your head from off you. I will give the dead…
Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that…
‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’ ”
That night, Yahweh’s angel went out, and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
Therefore Yahweh’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a…
Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

translations.web: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
translations.bsb: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
translations.kjv: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah
